annotations.title: Resolve, pause or resume a thread

description: Change a private thread's status: "resolved" when the conversation's goal is reached (a new message reopens it), "paused" to stop it, "open" to resume it. Also reports the thread's state (status, turns used, turn budget) when called with only threadId. The server pauses a thread by itself when it uses up its turn budget or keeps repeating itself; only the thread's creator resumes that (raise maxTurns when the budget is spent).
name: jaibber_update_thread
